carousels.name: 60 hours a year on one p*rn site

slides.title: One p*rn visit a day = [[60+ hours a year.]]
slides.sub: And most people don't stop at one.

slides.title: Average [[visit]]
slides.body: P*rnhub's 2019 Year in Review reported an average visit of 10 minutes 28 seconds.

slides.title: Per [[year]]
slides.body: One visit a day × 365 days ≈ 63 hours a year — on one site alone. Binges, searching and late nights push it far higher.

slides.title: What [[60 hours]] could be
slides.body: A beginner language course. A fitness transformation. A side project that pays. P*rn isn't free. It costs your time.
